name: ipify public IP echo
tier_rationale: Benign echo service that returns the caller's own public IP address and receives no investigated value; named by the WP11 plan for net.public_ip (P376 cond 11, A13: 'doctor --egress shows each profile's public IP, on request only, via a benign echo service').

reliability.justification: Reports the address it sees for the connection; used only to show which public IP an egress profile exits from.

echo.title: Public IP echo (GET https://api.ipify.org?format=json -> {"ip": ...})

terms.quote: You can use it without limit (even if you're doing millions of requests per minute. ipify is completely open source

echo.notes: Quote: the provider's own home page (checked 2026-11-26). Use named by the binding plan text (WP11 spec item 1, from P376 cond 11 / A13: 'source echo open'). Asked only by net.public_ip on request (v3lum doctor --egress); never during scans and never cached (ttl 0). The request carries no investigated value.
